Hi Audrey / Ben — assigning this to Security. Below is a concise mapping and the artifacts we typically provide for procurement.

Summary (answering your two asks):
- Default retention: tenant debug/session logs = 30 days (rolling).
- Exception window: up to 120 days for customer-scoped forensic/legal holds — exceptions require: written request, legal justification, customer PO or SOW referencing the hold, and approval from Security Lead + Product Ops. Exceptions are tracked and timeboxed; we remove the hold automatically at the approved end date unless a renewal request is received.
- Compensating controls: when a hold >30 days is approved we require either (a) scoped pseudonymization of PII in telemetry, or (b) access-limited escrow delivery to a mutually agreed secure S3 bucket for forensic retrieval.

CAIQ / SIG artifacts we will deliver to map to retention & deletion controls:
- CAIQ-evidence-sheet.pdf — high-level mapping of CAIQ questions to Redwood artifacts (retention-matrix, policy excerpts, logs access procedures).
- retention-matrix.csv — per-artifact TTL, storage tier, access controls, and proof-of-deletion process.
- redwood-data-retention-policy.pdf (excerpt included in CAIQ sheet).
- sample audit record extract (redacted) showing deletion job run and retention tag lifecycle (provided on request).

Key CAIQ control references: (examples we map)
- DI-01 (Data Inventory) -> retention-matrix.csv
- DI-03 (Retention & Disposal) -> redwood-data-retention-policy.pdf + CAIQ-evidence-sheet.pdf
- AC-07 (Role-based Access to Logs) -> IAM role list + audit extract (on request)

Operational steps for a retention carve-out:
1) Customer submits written request + justification (email + PO/SOW).
2) Redwood Security reviews + proposes compensating controls.
3) Approvals: Security Lead (Irene Choi) + Product Ops.
4) Security engineers implement hold, document start/end dates, and enable enhanced access controls.
5) At end date, hold automatically lifts and deletion jobs run; Customer gets export and a proof-of-delete artifact.

Delivery ETA for artifacts: I will assemble the CAIQ-evidence-sheet.pdf and retention-matrix.csv and upload to a shared Drive folder by EOD today (9/21). If you need the sample audit extract we can redact and provide it under an NDA addendum (let me know).

Attachments: CAIQ-evidence-sheet.pdf (pdf), retention-matrix.csv (csv)

Regards,
Irene Choi
Security Lead, Redwood Inference
